3.why: The hotel offers exactly one discretionary waiver, its terms permit either room and neither party has priority; the choice does not alter the strike, cancellation or musician's journey, so no-one-else is true. No claim to different force-majeure rights is stated; acceptance of uniform consumer terms by type remains a pilot issue.

7.why: Conflict-only intermediary requirement; this allocation body expressly denies both parties authority over the agent and the operator/fund.
